tags.name: Search API V1
tags.description: Execute searches across the extensive collection of tax and accounting content offered by Checkpoint.

tags.name: Search API V2
tags.description: The Search API for Checkpoint Edge provides the most accurate and up-to-date guidance about the ever-changing tax law and accounting standards. The API is powered by AI and machine-learning tools, to get targeted search results in less time.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: This is equivalent to categories(wgldictionary, orientation, quicktax and wgltreatises) under the checkpoint practice area such as federal, state & local etc..,.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
The number of search results to return in the response. The default is 10 and the maximum value that you may specify is 100. The actual number delivered may be less than requested.

Use this parameter along with the offset parameter to page results.

For example, if your user interface presents 10 search results per page, you would set count to 10 and offset to 0 to get the first page of results. For each subsequent page, you would increment offset by 10 (for example, 0, 10, 20). It is possible for multiple pages to include some overlap in results.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
The zero-based offset that indicates the number of search results to skip before returning results. The default is 0.

Use this parameter along with the count parameter to page results. For example, if your user interface presents 10 search results per page, you would set count to 10 and offset to 0 to get the first page of results. For each subsequent page, you would increment offset by 10 (for example, 0, 10, 20). It is possible for multiple pages to include some overlap in results.

parameters.name: practiceArea
parameters.description: This is equivalent to checkpoint practice area such as federal, state & local etc..,.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The user's search query string. The query string must not be empty.

post.summary: Execute a Checkpoint search in a Single Practice Area
post.description: This API allows executing a search in a single practice area using a single searchTerm and a list of sources. The response will include the total count, the corresponding search result identifier (searchId) and a list of documents found by the search.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
maximum number of documents to return in response
*Default value : 10*
*Maximum value : 100*

requestBody.description:
Search request parameters: searchTerm, practiceArea, sources, internationalParameters, and stateOptions.
1.The 'searchTerm' parameter[Required] is the string of text to use for searching.
2.The 'practiceArea' parameter[Required] is the practice area to search. Allowed values are: - federal - state-and-local - international-tax - pension-and-benefits - estate-planning - payroll - aacf 3.The 'sources'[Required] parameter is the list of Checkpoint sources to search (sourceIds from Sources API).
4.The 'internationalParameters' parameter[Optional] is the list of country codes for International-Tax search only.
5.The 'stateOptions' parameter[Optional] is the list of state codes , tax types and document types for state-and-local search only. Note: To find list of valid country codes for international-tax search. Please check 'Search API v2 - Country Code for International Search' under 'Getting Started' section.

200.description: Successful Response with list of individual search result in JSON format. The search response will include the total count, the corresponding search result identifier (searchId) and a list of documents found by the search.The list of documents returned by this API is limited to the number in the 'limit' url parameter. The default value will be returned when no limit is included in the request (see limit parameter description for default and maximum values). The documentList includes the unique document identifier (documentId), document title (title), Checkpoint Edge link (url), source label (source), source identifier (sourceId), sub source name (subSourceName), category (contentType),  document rank score (rankScore), snippet with search term (tagged under span with 'hit'class), state code (state), list of countries (countries) and the date when the document was published - if available (publishedDate).

400.description: Bad Request: 'Invalid Practice Area Value', 'Practice Area Value Is Required', 'Sources do not belong to the selected Practice Area', 'Selected Sources are Invalid', 'Invalid Country value(s)', 'Invalid State value(s).', 'Invalid Tax Type value(s)', 'Invalid Tax Types, do not belong to State(s)', 'Invalid Document Type value(s)'

403.description: Selected Sources are Outside your Subscription

get.summary: Retrieve the list of All Checkpoint supported countries by region
get.description: This API allows retrieving the list of countries (countryIds) used in Checkpoint.

parameters.name: regions
parameters.description:
List of regions  to retrieve countries from. Multiple  regions values can be provided separated by commas.
Example: ?regions=AFRI,ASPA,CARI

200.description: Successful Response with list of sources in JSON format

post.summary: Trigger a Checkpoint search across Multiple Practice Areas
post.description: This API provides the convenience of triggering multiple single Checkpoint searches at once, across each selected practice areas, using a single searchTerm and a list of sources. The response will include the total count per practice area and the corresponding search result identifier (searchId), that allows retrieving each result set using the Search Results API

requestBody.description:
Search request parameters: searchTerm, practiceAreas, sources, internationalParameters, and stateOptions.
1.The 'searchTerm' parameter[Required] is the string of text to use for searching.
2.The 'practiceAreas' parameter[Required] is the list of practice areas to search. Allowed values are: - federal - state-and-local - international-tax - pension-and-benefits - estate-planning - payroll - aacf 3.The 'sources' parameter[Required] is the list of Checkpoint sources to search (sourceIds from Sources API). There is no need to separate the sources by practice area. The API will map each sourceId to the corresponding practice area.
4.The 'internationalParameters' parameter[Optional] is the list of country codes for International-Tax search only.
5.The 'stateOptions' parameter[Optional] is the list of state codes , tax types and document types for state-and-local search only. Note: To find list of valid country codes for international-tax search. Please check 'Search API v2 - Country Code for International Search' under 'Getting Started' section.

200.description: Successful Response with list of individual search result by Practice Area in JSON format.The response will include the totalCount of all practice areas combined, a searchUrl that allows the execution of the same search across multiple practice areas on Checkpoint Edge,and a list of results per practice area. The results include the total count per practice area, a searchUrl that allows the execution of the same search for that practice area in Checkpoint Edge, and the corresponding search result identifier (searchId), that allows retrieving each result set using the Search Results API

400.description: Bad Request: 'Invalid Practice Area Value', 'Practice Area Value Is Required','Sources do not belong to the selected Practice Area', 'Selected Sources are Invalid', 'Invalid Country value(s)', 'Invalid State value(s).', 'Invalid Tax Type value(s)', 'Invalid Tax Types, do not belong to State(s)', 'Invalid Document Type value(s)'

403.description: Selected Sources are Outside your Subscription

get.summary: Retrieve the list of All Checkpoint Sources by Practice Area
get.description: This API allows retrieving the list of sources (sourceIds) to be used as an input when searching Checkpoint content using the Federated or Single search APIs.

parameters.name: practiceAreas
parameters.description:
List of Practice Areas to retrieve sources from. Multiple practice areas values can be provided separated by commas.
Example: ?practiceAreas=federal,state-and-local,payroll

200.description: Successful Response with list of sources in JSON format

400.description: Bad Request: 'Invalid Practice Area Value', 'Practice Area Value Is Required'

200.description: Successful Response with list of document types in JSON format

get.summary: Retrieve the list of all user subscribed states
get.description: This API allows retrieving the list of states to be used as an input when searching Checkpoint content using the Federated or Single search APIs.

200.description: Successful Response with list of states in JSON format

get.summary: Retrieve the list of All Checkpoint tax types for a given state
get.description: This API allows retrieving the list of tax types used in Checkpoint.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description:
List of states to retrieve tax types. Multiple  state values can be provided separated by commas.
Example: ?states=CA,CO,MN

200.description: Successful Response with list of sources in JSON format

get.summary: Paginate through Individual Search Results by ID
get.description: This API allows retrieving and paginating through a previously executed search against a single practice area

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
maximum number of documents to return in response 
*Default value : 10*
*Maximum value : 100*

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
offset results (for pagination). The offset is the starting point in the results. It is the desired
starting point in the array of documents in the search result. Limit is required when offset is present.

Example:
 limit=20&offset=0 : returns items 0-19
 limit=20&offset=20 : returns items 20-39

parameters.name: searchId
parameters.description: ID of search result to be retrieved (searchId)

200.description: Successful Response with list of individual search result in JSON format. The search response will include the total count, the corresponding search result identifier (searchId) and a list of documents found by the search. The number of documents returned by this API is limited to the number in the 'limit' url parameter, however the client can paginate through the results using the offset parameter (see limit and offset parameter description for default and maximum values). The documentList includes the unique document identifier (documentId), document title (title), Checkpoint Edge link (url), source label (source), document rank score (rankScore), source identifier (sourceId), sub source name (subSourceName), category (contentType), snippet with search term (tagged under span with 'hit'class), state code (state), tax types , document types ,list of countries (countries) and the date when the document was published - if available (publishedDate).
